## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e4db4ca4e33c60a276697ea57de04951d3c1ac46`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

Inputs read: card #33718 (body, ruling 6891082225, claim 6891305028, os-dev-report 6891627453), PR #33731 (body, four files, net diff against merge base `48e69596`), and the check-runs on the head. Read to judge, not reviewed: ruling 6797014134 on #32179, the ratchet header's raise rule, `landing-operations.md` L13, and the claim 6891021684 on #33647.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set or public-surface change: the diff is three pm-dispatch reference files and two `CEILINGS` rows. Nothing in `packages/**`, no schema, no gate logic. Right.
- The review default is unchanged. `contract-review.md` L41-42 keeps 「仅 nit 即终轮」 and the three nit outlets; only 「转后续卡」 becomes 「转 PR 后续卡」, and one character moved lines to hold 120 bytes. The 2026-11-07/08 ruling (#31179, PR #31289) stands. Right.
- The 11-11 ruling 6797014134 stands: `triage-duties.md` L74 still keeps ADR and skills text off implementation cards, with the ADR line still filed by the landing seat after merge. Only the count changes (one `domain:skills` card per PR). Right.
- Ceiling raises: `filing-gate.md` 79 to 82 with exactly +3 lines and 0 removed; `triage-duties.md` 103 to 104 with +2 and -1. Both files measure 82 and 104 lines on the head, and every added line is at most 120 bytes. Each row moves by exactly its delta. Right.
- Check-runs on the head: no failure, cancellation or timeout. Completed with success: Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Type Check workspace, Type Check debt ledger, Lint scoped tooling self-tests, Lint scoped query-options erasure, Plan Test Core shards, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, filter, Auto Label. STILL RUNNING when this record was written: Lint PM dispatch-gates, Lint repo and tooling gates, Lint CI release and engine gates, Lint docs and code guards, Lint scoped slot lookup and corpus, Lint ESLint, Type Check consumer gates, Type Check source gates, Test Core 1/8 and 2/8. The ratchet and skill-id-lint verdicts ride in those pending lint jobs, so this record does not vouch for them; the seat reads them green before landing.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is correct: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing, and Check Changeset is green on the head.
Clause-②: no. Agreed: no path under `packages/spec/src/**`, no accept or declaration surface.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Deviation 1, the ceiling raise against the order's first wording: answered. The ratchet header (ruling 6184799323, letter B) authorises a raise when the ruling of record orders the text, and the PR body quotes the id 6891082225 and both measured deltas. The four added lines are items 1, 2, 3 and 4 of the card as rewritten on that ruling; the tail of L37 is a pointer that shares item 3's line and costs no line.
- Deviation 2, `landing-operations.md` L13 left out: see nit N1. Leaving it to #33647 PR 2 is sound in principle (that claim's file surface names the file, one card per file at a time), but the owed line is recorded only on this PR, not on #33647.
- Out-of-scope note on spec wording: accepted. Ruling 6797014134 lists `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `SKILL.md` and `os-dev.md` only, so naming spec in L74 would widen it. The card's 「(or spec)」 goes beyond the ruling it cites.
- `open_questions`: none. Security findings: none.
- Author: the PR's `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no off-relay note is owed. The PR is still a draft.

### ④ Design judgment

**`filing-gate.md` (L35-37).** Placement is right: the seat that files reads this file, and the three lines sit directly under the quota line they qualify. The dedupe line merges only 「同一发现」, which is item 3's limit. One finding:

- **S1, should-fix.** L35 opens with 「例外」 to the per-defect quota and lists 「同车道 diff 外发现」 with no limit on what kind of finding. Read literally, a real product defect that a review finds outside the diff in the same lane (gate ①, with `reach:`, possibly p1 or p2) becomes one tick item on a card titled `review follow-ups of PR #N`. That card has one category line, one grade and one dispatch, and the grading rule puts review nits and tails at p3. The card's item 3 says the per-defect rule (#25687) still holds for real defects, and the PR body says 「a real defect still gets its own card」. The text delivers that only for a must-fix on a landed head (`contract-review.md` L57), not for an out-of-diff defect. The fix is in place and costs no line: say in L35 that a gate ① defect keeps its own card, or narrow the third member of the list to findings that are not ① defects. If the seat instead reads the card as folding every same-lane out-of-diff finding, that reading has to be stated in the text, with how the checklist card is graded when one item is a defect.

**`contract-review.md` (L41-42, L57).** Both edits hold. L57 「立卡」 keeps one card per must-fix, graded by finding, and stops forcing a new card when the search hits the same finding.

- **N2, nit.** L42 names 「PR 后续卡」 but does not point to `filing-gate.md`, where the title, the append rule and the search live; `contract-review.md` cites that file nowhere. The PR body says the clause 「points to the filing rule」; it does so only by the term. Accepted deviation or a follow-up item.

**`triage-duties.md` (L16, L74).** L16 puts the flow line where triage reads its round-record duties, and its six counts match item 4. The body's claim that no rule text carried it is true (no other hit for the flow counts under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch`).

- **N3, nit.** L16 says 「每 3 小时」, but no rule text defines a 3-hourly round or board refresh (the round record is per fire; the only other 3h rules are the progress knocks). Which fire carries the line is left to the seat. Accepted deviation.
- **N4, nit.** L74 「余每 PR 一 `domain:skills` 卡」 sits in the triage-time splitting rules, where the PR often does not exist yet; it reads as one card per implementing PR or implementation card. The ADR half keeps no count. Accepted deviation.

**`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (implementing file).** The two rows agree with the header rule sentence by sentence: the ruling id is quoted, the deltas are the measured ones, neither row is a `CROSS_FILE_MOVES` destination, headroom is 0, and the comments describe the lines that actually landed. `contract-review.md` stays at 63. No finding.

**Residual rule text on `main`.** A search of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch` and `AGENTS.md` at the head for 立新卡, 后续卡 and 转后续 leaves one conflicting line: `landing-operations.md` L13 「发现立新卡」. The hits in `cross-repo-coordination.md` L44 and `filing-gate.md` L39 are other rules. `execution-duties.md` L110 is the dispatch-time split and is rightly untouched.

- **N1, nit.** L13 is the landing seat's entry to a retro review, the case item 3 was written for, and it still says 「立新卡」. The harm is small, because L13 sends the reader to `contract-review.md`, whose L57 now says 「立卡」. The carry itself is the weak point: `filing-gate.md` says 「搭下个碰 X 的 PR」 is not a `carrier:`, and #33647 carries no comment naming this owed line, so the PR 2 dev and its reviewer cannot see it. No head move is needed: the seat records the owed L13 edit on #33647 (or on the follow-up card of this PR) before landing.

**Verdict basis.** No must-fix. S1 is a should-fix and earns a delta review of its fix on the new head. N1 to N4 are nits.

Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `51787fa637280b090c8fe63b35fafe7798fc0869`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

DELTA review from `e4db4ca4` (record 6891667603) to this head. Two commits: `afffd197` (filing-gate.md L35-36) and `51787fa6` (contract-review.md L51). The delta is 3 lines added and 3 removed in two files; triage-duties.md and the ratchet script are byte-identical to the reviewed head, and their judgments in record 6891667603 stand.

Inputs read: card #33718 with ruling 6891082225, claim 6891305028 and os-dev-report 6891627453; PR #33731 body, its four-file list and the net diff against main; record 6891667603; card #33604 with its comments; PR #33736 (body, three-file list) and its record 6891926185; the check-runs on this head. Read to judge, not reviewed: SKILL.md L202 (the Tier S and Tier H definition) and filing-gate.md L8-10 (the gate categories).

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set, schema or gate-logic change in the delta: two rule-text lines in filing-gate.md and one in contract-review.md. Right.
- Ceilings, read off the head tree: contract-review.md 63 lines (ceiling 63), filing-gate.md 82 (ceiling 82), triage-duties.md 104 (ceiling 104). The delta adds and removes the same number of lines in each file, and the `CEILINGS` rows are untouched. Right.
- Line width: the three changed lines measure 120 bytes (filing-gate L35), 119 (L36) and 120 (contract-review L51). The only lines over 120 bytes in the two files are contract-review L22-23 and filing-gate L5, all outside the diff and unchanged since before this PR.
- The review default is unchanged: contract-review L41-42 are not in the delta, so 「仅 nit 即终轮」 and the delta-review trigger 「有前两级才」 read as they did.
- Check-runs on the head: no failure, cancellation or timeout. Concluded success: Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter, Type Check source gates, Lint ESLint, Lint scoped tooling self-tests, Lint scoped query-options erasure, Plan Test Core shards, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate. STILL PENDING when this was written: Lint PM dispatch-gates, Lint repo and tooling gates, Lint CI release and engine gates, Lint docs and code guards, Lint scoped slot lookup and corpus, Type Check workspace, Type Check consumer gates, Type Check debt ledger, Test Core 1/8 and 2/8. The ratchet and skill-id-lint verdicts ride in the pending lint jobs; this record does not vouch for them, and the seat reads them green before landing.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `skip-changeset` is right (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing). Clause-②: no, agreed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The L51 edit is carried for card #33604, whose claim allowed at most one line of contract-review.md and whose PR #33736 leaves the file to this card. It is inside this card's claimed file surface, costs no line, and the PR body names it under What changes and Acceptance notes. Record 6891926185 asked for exactly this carry before PR #33736 lands. Accepted.
- The PR body's account of round 1 matches the tree: the first finding fixed in place, N2 not taken (L41 and L42 sit at 120 bytes), N3 and N4 accepted as they are, and the landing-operations.md L13 line carried in PR #33732's diff.
- The PR is authored by `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no off-relay note is owed.

### ④ Design judgment

**filing-gate.md L35-36 (commit `afffd197`).**

- **S1: closed.** L36 now reads 「后轮追加 ⛔ 不另立;① 缺陷仍各立;」. In this file ① is the gate category defined at L9-10 (a product defect with a named site or a repro, carrying `reach:`), so the clause says what the card's item 3 and the PR body promised: a gate ① defect that a review finds outside the diff keeps its own card under the quota line (L34) and is not a tick item. It sits inside the exception it limits, directly after the list it qualifies, and cost no line.
- The three shortenings lose nothing. 「接受偏差」 sits in a noun list between 「nit」 and 「同车道 diff 外发现」 and can only be read as the accepted deviation. 「每 PR 一卡」 keeps the count, which is the rule; 「合」 added nothing. 「后轮追加」 has no other candidate subject: the sentence opens with 「复核后续」, so the later round is a later review of the same PR.
- N5 (nit) — two spellings, no change of meaning. The code span on L35 now runs straight into 「逐项勾」 with no separator, and the term reads 「接受偏差」 here but 「接受的偏差」 in contract-review.md L42. A tick item for the PR's follow-up card, or an accepted deviation.

**contract-review.md L51 (commit `51787fa6`).**

- The rule matches the guard. PR #33736's `recordPassVerdict` clears a Tier S entry only on a same-head record with one PASS line that names no open finding of the upper two grades. L51 ① now reads 「现 head 同形达档 PASS 在案,无前两级」: a same-head, same-shape, at-tier PASS on record, with neither upper grade. 「前两级」 is the term L41 defines ten lines up (the first two of the three finding grades), and L41 uses it for the same trigger, so the two lines now state one rule from both ends: upper grades earn a delta review (L41), and the pre-check does not pass while they stand (L51).
- Consistent with 「仅 nit 即终轮」 (L42): a nits-only record has neither upper grade and passes ① unchanged.
- Consistent with L52-53: a prose-only move lets the original record carry, and 「重挂照 ①」 sends the re-arm through the same sentence, so a carried record that still names an upper-grade finding does not pass. That is what the guard does with a carried record (record 6891926185, ① last bullet).
- The S and H shortening is unambiguous. The file's only other tier mention is L14 「Tier H 人批」, the pair is defined at SKILL.md L202, which itself continues with a bare 「S 经达档 PASS 后」, and the verbs 「入队」 and 「等人批」 fix which is which. Finding ids of the form S1 never appear in this file, and grades are 「级」 while tiers are 「档」, so 「前两级」 cannot be read as the two tiers.
- Order of landing: no contradiction either way. L51 is the seat's own pre-check (「请审/求批与落地前检」), so with this PR first the seat reads the grades by hand while the guard still reads only the PASS line: the rule is stricter than the gate, which is the safe direction, and it is the second arm card #33604 itself offered (「or the seat's pre-landing check does, and the rule text says which」). With PR #33736 first, the guard would refuse on a rule the text does not state; landing this line first removes that gap. Nothing in L51 depends on the guard's record grammar, so the two open findings on PR #33736 do not touch it.
- N6 (nit) — 「无前两级」 leaves two things to the reader: that a finding a later same-head record closes no longer counts (the newest record governs, per the template), and how a finding closed with no head move, on the PR body or the prose face, gets cleared (a later same-head record). Both are stated only in PR #33736's refusal text and brief lines. Record 6891926185 took this sentence as sufficient, and at 120 bytes on a 63/63 file there is no room for more. Accepted deviation, or a tick item when #33716 next opens the file.

**Nothing else moved.** No other line of the three reference files or of `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` differs between the two heads.

No must-fix, no should-fix. N5 and N6 are nits and end the round; with N2, N3 and N4 of record 6891667603 they go to the PR's follow-up card or stand as accepted deviations.

Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb`

**VERDICT: PASS**
